content: Installer restructured: cleanup.go moved to utils/cleanup (single Cleanup func called before hostPhase and after firstboot), features moved to utils/firstboot (install_config + secureboot + tpm with chmod 755 after copy). hostPhase now 4 steps only. main.go 7-step flow: cleanup-hostPhase-chrootPhase-firstboot-cleanup. Harness: harness.log captures stdout+stderr, LUKS inject uses serialLogLastLineHas (last line only, not count), swtpm restart unconditional
